verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable in the hashicorp/terraform GitHub repository (terraform-gh-1). Community posts point to an open project: users submit pull requests, maintainers require a CLA, and a 2021 comment thanks HashiCorp for 'keeping it open source'. No first-party document in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story rests only on an old community remark. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the license terms, current independent confirmation that the license is open/OSI-approved.
